public_rationale: No qualifying default was established by the retrieved evidence. SoftBank's completed investment provides financing context, but it neither proves that all bills were paid nor rules out a future default. The prediction has no deadline, so the absence of a documented event cannot establish failure.
limitations: Private payment arrangements may not be public.
The claim supplies no accounting basis for a numerical solvency test.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point OpenAI will be unable to pay a creditor who refuses equity or IOUs.

statement.excerpt: And at some point, OpenAI will simply not be able to pay its bills, or more precisely, it will have to hand over money to somebody who will not accept equity or IOUs in return.

from_speaker: OpenAI will simply not be able to pay its bills
somebody who will not accept equity or IOUs in return
our_interpretation: The predicted event is an inability to make a due cash payment to a creditor who rejects equity or deferred payment.
A disputed invoice, voluntary payment delay, operating loss, or need to raise capital does not by itself establish inability to pay.
No deadline is stated. The surrounding discussion of year-end funding needs does not supply a deadline for this separate prediction.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records establish a due payment that OpenAI could not make in cash and the creditor's refusal to accept equity or deferral.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive termination of OpenAI with all obligations settled, and no qualifying default during its existence, would contradict the prediction. Continued solvency for a finite period would not.
